answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 4161 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Can we keep these names for girls and what is the meaning . 1-BANAFSHA, 2-SHANUM, 3-ADIFAAH Question: Asslamoalaikum Can we keep these names for girls and what is the meaning . 1-BANAFSHA, 2-SHANUM, 3-ADIFAAH Jazakallah Answer ID: 4161 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 244/244=M/1429) (1) Banafsha is a kind of flower and a self-growing plant used for influenza and cold. You can name a girl Banafsha . (2) Shanum has many meanings in dictionary; some are good while some are bad; therefore it is better to choose any other name. (3) Meaning of Adifaah could not be found in dictionary. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
